app.name: ApplyTrack
app.tagline: All your job applications in one place

start.title: Organise your job search
start.description: Log every opening, see where each one stands and never miss a follow-up.
start.tryDemoHint: With sample data. Everything is stored on this device only.
start.signInUnavailable: Accounts aren't configured in this environment.

auth.title: Sign in to ApplyTrack
auth.description: We'll email you a link. No passwords.
auth.checkDescription: We've sent a link to {email}. Open it in this browser to sign in.
auth.resendIn: You can resend it in {seconds} s
auth.resendReady: You can resend the email now.
auth.callbackFailedTitle: We couldn't sign you in with this link
auth.callbackFailedDescription: It may have expired, already been used or been opened in a different browser. Request a new one or enter the code from the email.
auth.spamHint: If you can't find it, check your spam folder.

demo.banner: Demo mode · data is only stored on this device
demo.resetConfirm: Your changes will be deleted and the sample data reloaded. Continue?

board.title: Board
board.tooMany: There are {total} applications and the board shows the 500 most recent. Use the list to see them all.

card.staleHint: No changes for more than {days} days

results.count: {count, plural, =0 {No applications} one {# application} other {# applications}}

empty.noneDescription: Add your first one to start tracking it.

feedback.errorDescription: The applications could not be loaded.

settings.title: Settings
settings.demoDescription: Data is only stored on this device.
settings.syncFailedTitle: Saved on this device, but not to your account

stats.title: Statistics
stats.notSentYet: You have not sent any applications yet.
stats.weekLabel: Week of {date}: {count, plural, =0 {none} one {# sent} other {# sent}}
stats.medianHint: Median time from sending an application to the first response.

hints.tags: Press Enter or type a comma to add it.

form.statusHint: The status is changed from the application details.
form.saveError: The application could not be saved. Please try again.
form.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
form.notFound: The application could not be found.

detail.title: Application
detail.archivedNotice: This application is archived: it does not appear on the board or in the list.
detail.deleteWarning: Its details and history will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
detail.actionError: The action could not be completed.

errors.INVALID_OPTION: Choose an option from the list.
errors.INVALID_URL: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://.
errors.INVALID_SALARY_RANGE: The minimum salary cannot be higher than the maximum, and amounts must be positive.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY: Unsupported currency. Use EUR, GBP or USD.
errors.FUTURE_DATE: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.APPLIED_AT_NOT_ALLOWED: An application marked as “Interested” has no application date yet.
errors.APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND: The application could not be found.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: It is not possible to move from “{from}” to “{to}”.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You've requested too many emails. Wait a few minutes.
errors.INVALID_CODE: The code is invalid or has expired.
errors.AUTH_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't connect. Check your connection.
errors.SYNC_FAILED: The change was applied here, but couldn't be saved to your account.

notify.archivedDescription: It no longer appears on the board.

mobile.comingSoonDescription: This screen will arrive in an upcoming version of the app.
mobile.checkDescription: We've sent a link to {email}. Open it on this phone to sign in.
mobile.tunnelHint: Supabase doesn't accept return addresses with an IP. To sign in with email in Expo Go, start the app with “pnpm dev:mobile:tunnel”.
